text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Right before the Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was also invited to the 
program featuring all the Umamusume 
running in the race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It's Biko Pegasus! Hey everyone watching 
at home! I'm still a rookie, but please 
cheer for me!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Biko Pegasus. Let's see what a 
hero-loving Umamusume's running can do.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what's next? One of the 
strongest Umamusume is making her 
entrance! Thanks to her dazzling aura, the 
studio right now is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"It has transformed into a runway of 
light! Striding gracefully down the turf's 
flower path, the 'Fashion Leader of the 
Mile' is—"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: North Flight!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Rocking my favorite style today too♪ 
Let's make it a great one!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flight-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O isn't the only one at 
the top of the sprint division! We have 
this Umamusume right here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Flight-san, looking sharp as 
ever today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this race another memorable 
chapter in the rivalry between the Peak 
Class Rep and the Trendsetter!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Bakushin O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and North Flight stand 
side by side. Indeed, the two of them are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were truly the dominant top two 
currently reigning over the Twinkle Series 
sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after the broadcast ended—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Between Bakushin O-senpai 
and Flight-senpai, who's stronger?"
choice_data_list: That... depends on the distance, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are incredibly strong in 
sprints. However, if I had to say...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O at 1,200m. North Flight 
at 1,600m. That was the record between 
them so far.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, when it comes to the mile, it's 
Flight-senpai... Up until now, I only had 
eyes for Bakushin O-senpai, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A third-party enemy, huh... In Carrotman, 
it wasn't just the 'Unhealthy 
Empire'—halfway through, the 
'Sleep-Deprived Corps' showed up too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, I won't lose to Flight-senpai 
either!
Um... do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm, who's that?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan. Great job on the broadcast♪"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The Sleep-Deprived Brigade!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not that, Flight-senpai! What's the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to talk to you. About 
Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-senpai's?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, along with North Flight, the three 
of us left the studio.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, the other day, Bakushin-chan 
confided something in me."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Something of great importance that could 
heavily impact the future of the sprint 
division.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I simply won too much. 
Especially in sprints, where I stood alone 
at the top for so long.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did my best for the sake of the sprint 
division, but... perhaps I grew too 
strong, as few are willing to take me on 
with genuine intent to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The hot, intense racing that I yearn 
for... feels like it's drifting further 
away the more I desire it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"This can't go on. If I'm not feeling 
fulfilled myself, and if I'm robbing 
everyone else of their drive as well..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking it might be time for me to 
step down. At the upcoming Mile 
Championship.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan... Are you being serious?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because of you and me, the sprint division 
got this exciting! If one of us is 
missing...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Am I... not enough? Does my running not 
make your heart flutter?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san's running is magnificent. 
However, since our preferred distances 
differ slightly, it doesn't feel like a 
completely all-out battle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, let's at least give it our all 
until the end! And after that, I'll leave 
everything in your capable hands."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...And that's what happened. I just 
really wanted to tell you about it, 
Biko-chan."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-senpai did that...? Then...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Was her cheerful demeanor all just an act? 
Was she feeling lonely lately without any 
sprint rivals?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Even so, to liven up the sprint 
division, she kept running without ever 
letting anyone see what went on behind the 
scenes.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's painful for me, it's all to 
entertain everyone...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai... A hero... A real 
one...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! I don't want Bakushin 
O-senpai to just leave like this!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything I can do? For the sake 
of Bakushin O-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by the question, I ponder. In a 
manner of speaking, Sakura Bakushin O was 
suffering from burnout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, with that much energy... she might 
have limitless class rep power hidden deep 
down. If so—
choice_data_list: There is... something we can do!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And what—is that?
choice_data_list:
We need to reignite that fire once more in 
the race!

We just need to reignite that fire once 
more in the race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"A fire from racing... I see. Because so 
few rivals try to beat her in earnest, 
Senpai's inner fire is starting to 
fade..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just have to fire them up with 
running that's many times more amazing 
than before!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Biko-chan. I really intended to 
see this through all on my own. But... I 
just couldn't do it...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"If Biko-chan is lending her strength too! 
Then I won't let anyone say the fight is 
over!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it, Flight-senpai! We'll 
show Bakushin O-senpai both our runs at 
the very same time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to racing with you, 
Biko-san! Let's run a race today without a 
single regret.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-senpai... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's the matter, Biko-san?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I didn't understand a single thing about 
Bakushin O-senpai. She's always so 
cheerful, I thought she never had any 
worries.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, it must've been lonely having no 
rivals alongside you in sprints. I'm 
sorry... for not noticing sooner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, please don't mind it. That's just 
how committee chairs are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this the best race ever today. 
You want to beat me, don't you, Biko-san?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to win. I really want to win. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to do even more 
than winning!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to throw all my power at Bakushin 
O-senpai and make it thrilling. And then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to save her! From that loneliness! 
Senpai has helped everyone up until now, 
so this time, it's my turn to help her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Biko-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, such deeply touching words! Yes, 
please, by all means!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash fiercely, just like old 
times! Until not even ashes remain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san, are you good with that too!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! I'll coordinate this race 
to absolute perfection♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! I'm gonna move 
Bakushin O-senpai's heart once more...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it burn bright red! Carrot 
Energy, mega spark!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus is brimming with motivation. 
Now, to repay Sakura Bakushin O, the 
two-stage transformation begins!
